    7. If placement is possible, calls `place_or_delete(i, j, a, b, 1)` to place the rectangle on the grid.
    8. Recursively calls `dfs(S-{idx})` to continue the search with the remaining rectangles (bug is here).
    9. Calls `place_or_delete(i, j, a, b, 0)` to remove the rectangle from the grid, regardless of the outcome of the recursive call.
]
